metadata.case_name: KWAN KAM PUI v. 馮文 AND OTHERS

losses.description: PSLA as assessed in the parties' breakdown: Plaintiff’s assessment (HKD) PSLA 700,000; ECA Fund Board assessment (HKD) PSLA 500,000
Pre-trial loss of earnings and MPF as assessed in the parties' breakdown: Plaintiff’s assessment (HKD) Pre-trial loss of earnings and MPF 70,000; ECA Fund Board assessment (HKD) 100,000
Post-trial loss of earnings as assessed in the parties' breakdown: Plaintiff’s assessment (HKD) Post-trial loss of earnings 575,069; ECA Fund Board assessment (HKD) 588,823
Loss of earning capacity as assessed in the parties' breakdown: Plaintiff’s assessment (HKD) Loss of earning capacity 530,788; ECA Fund Board assessment (HKD) 442,323
Special Damages (pre-trial) as assessed in the parties' breakdown: Plaintiff’s assessment (HKD) 32,733; ECA Fund Board assessment (HKD) 30,000
Special Damages (post-trial) as assessed in the parties' breakdown: Plaintiff’s assessment (HKD) 15,010; ECA Fund Board assessment (HKD) 11,060

Settlement terms recorded in the judgment: parties sought order that the ECA Fund Board pay the plaintiff a sum of $1,850,000, inclusive of interest, in full and final settlement of the plaintiff’s claim; settlement to be satisfied by credit for $1,050,000 employees’ compensation already received and balance $800,000 to be paid by the ECA Fund Board within 28 days
